title: 'It Runs Doom' on a Pregnancy Test? Not Quite
topic: The viral 2020 hack swapped in a new screen and a chip that streamed Doom from a PC; the test's own chip never ran it. 'Can it run Doom?' is a 33-year-old hacker joke.
audience: Everyday phone/PC/internet/game/AI-chat users who have seen this themselves
whyCare: 11M on the meme; nobody says it wasn't really running Doom. Anniversary + Game Awards day.
